title: Pipeline
statementMd:
Vova, the Ultimate Thule new shaman, wants to build a pipeline. As there are exactly $*n*$ houses in Ultimate Thule, Vova wants the city to have exactly $*n*$ pipes, each such pipe should be connected to the water supply. A pipe can be connected to the water supply if there's water flowing out of it. Initially Vova has only one pipe with flowing water. Besides, Vova has several splitters.

A splitter is a construction that consists of one input (it can be connected to a water pipe) and $*x*$ output pipes. When a splitter is connected to a water pipe, water flows from each output pipe. You can assume that the output pipes are ordinary pipes. For example, you can connect water supply to such pipe if there's water flowing out from it. At most one splitter can be connected to any water pipe.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c0ed2dfca233f5178237c977e6afa00a5760235e.png) The figure shows a $4$-output splitter

Vova has one splitter of each kind: with $2$, $3$, $4$, ..., $*k*$ outputs. Help Vova use the minimum number of splitters to build the required pipeline or otherwise state that it's impossible.

Vova needs the pipeline to have exactly $*n*$ pipes with flowing out water. Note that some of those pipes can be the output pipes of the splitters.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$, $2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$).

Please, do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of splitters needed to build the pipeline. If it is impossible to build a pipeline with the given splitters, print -1.
statementZhMd:
Vova 是 Ultimate Thule 的终极萨满，他想要建造一条管道。由于 Ultimate Thule 中恰好有 $*n*$ 座房屋，Vova 希望城市中恰好有 $*n*$ 根管道，并且每根管道都应与供水系统相连。如果一根管道中有水流出，那么它就可以与供水系统相连。起初，Vova 只有一根有水流出的管道。此外，Vova 还有若干个分流器。

分流器是一种装置，它有一个输入端（可以与一根水管相连）和 $*x*$ 个输出管道。当分流器与一根水管相连时，水会从每个输出管道中流出。你可以认为输出管道都是普通管道。例如，如果一根输出管道中有水流出，就可以将供水系统与它相连。每根水管至多可以连接一个分流器。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c0ed2dfca233f5178237c977e6afa00a5760235e.png) 图中展示了一个有 $4$ 个输出端的分流器。

Vova 每种分流器各有一个：输出端数量分别为 $2$、$3$、$4$、……、$*k*$。请帮助 Vova 使用最少数量的分流器建造所需的管道；如果无法做到，请说明这一点。

Vova 需要使管道中恰好有 $*n*$ 根管道能流出水。注意，其中一些管道可以是分流器的输出管道。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$，$2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符来读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流，或使用 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——建造该管道所需的最少分流器数量。如果使用给定的分流器无法建造出所需的管道，则输出 -1。
